body:
A decimal is another way to write a fraction with a denominator of 10 or 100.

3/10 = 0.3 (three tenths)
45/100 = 0.45 (forty-five hundredths)

Tenths and hundredths are related: 3/10 = 30/100, so 0.3 = 0.30.

Money uses decimals every day. A dime is one tenth of a dollar ($0.10) and a penny is one hundredth of a dollar ($0.01).

In this unit we write decimals, place them on a number line, and compare them. Which is greater, 0.4 or 0.38? You will find out!
title: Fractions in Disguise
